experiences.title: Bachelor of Engineering in Electronics & Telecommunication
experiences.description: Electronics Engineering student specializing in embedded systems, firmware development, and IoT solutions.
experiences.fullDescription:
Currently pursuing a Bachelor of Engineering in Electronics & Telecommunication at Vidyalankar Institute of Technology. My academic focus includes embedded systems, microcontroller programming, RTOS, IoT architectures, and hardware–software integration.

I actively work on hands-on projects involving ESP32, PCB design, real-time systems, and full-stack development. I maintain a strong CGPA of 8.0/10, placing me in the top 20% of my class.
highlights: Strong focus on embedded systems and IoT
Active participation in technical clubs and events

experiences.title: Software Head
experiences.description: Led end-to-end development of the college tech-fest platform and backend systems.
experiences.fullDescription:
As Software Head of the V Clubs Committee, I led the complete development lifecycle of the college tech-fest platform. I designed and implemented RESTful APIs, authentication mechanisms, and database schemas while managing a team of developers.

I ensured timely delivery, system scalability, and high availability during peak traffic events.
highlights: Integrated JWT authentication and REST APIs
Delivered project 2 weeks ahead of schedule

experiences.title: Smart WiFi Digital Watch (ESP32)
experiences.description: ESP32-based smart digital watch with WiFi time sync and power-optimized firmware.
experiences.fullDescription:
Designed and developed a smart WiFi-enabled digital watch using ESP32 and GC9A01 display. Implemented NTP-based time synchronization achieving 95% accuracy.

Optimized firmware using deep sleep modes, extending battery life by 3x. Built an HTTP-based file system managing 50+ files on SD card with high reliability.
highlights: Integrated RTC, stopwatch, and alarm features

experiences.title: Autonomous Line Follower & Maze Solver Robot
experiences.description: ESP32-based autonomous robot with line following and maze-solving capabilities.
experiences.fullDescription:
Designed a custom PCB and developed firmware using FreeRTOS for an autonomous robot capable of line following and maze solving. Implemented a recursive backtracking algorithm achieving 95% maze-solving accuracy.

Integrated WiFi-based real-time control interface with latency under 100ms.

experiences.title: ESP32 Sensor Dashboard Mobile App
experiences.description: Android application for real-time ESP32 sensor data visualization.
experiences.fullDescription:
Developed a Kotlin-based Android application using MVVM architecture to visualize real-time sensor data from ESP32 devices. Implemented efficient data handling with updates every 500ms and achieved 99.5% data accuracy.

Optimized memory usage and ensured responsive UI across multiple screen sizes.
